name: Yaogan 50-04
location_str: LC-9A @ Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
destination_explanation: Being close to the ground is the point: signals arrive quickly and cameras see fine detail, which is why internet and imaging satellites settle here.
slot_a_text: The Yaogan 50-04 is a Chinese military “remote sensing” satellite of unknown purposes.
slot_b_text: LC-9A has flown 31 launches since its first in 2022, 11 of them this year. Its previous launch was 35 days earlier.
